t: This is South of the River, a sculpture by Bernard Schottlander. Schottlander was a German-born British designer and sculptor, who lived from 1924 to 1999. His archive is kept at the University of Brighton Design Archives, so his working papers survive there. Take a moment to walk around the piece and look at how its forms sit against the space around it. The title suggests a view of London, though I can't tell you more about what he intended.
